title: Optional private task-event component configuration

driver.description: Select the one initial transport. string; only nats_jetstream. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

endpoint.description: Select the exact private broker TLS authority. string; tls:// DNS/localhost/private-IP with explicit canonical port 1..65535; no URL credentials/path/query. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

dial_addresses.description: Pin allowed private broker network destinations. compact JSON array of 1..8 unique canonical RFC1918/ULA/loopback IP strings; literal endpoint IP must be included. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

ca_file.description: Reference the private broker trust anchors. absolute canonical protected CA file path; distinct from every other reference. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

client_certificate_file.description: Reference the actual mTLS client certificate. absolute canonical protected certificate file path; distinct references. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

client_key_file.description: Reference the actual mTLS private key. absolute canonical protected secret-file path; never literal key material. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

publisher_seed_file.description: Reference the restricted publisher NKey identity. absolute canonical protected secret-file path; private seed never enters env/log/browser. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

consumer_seed_file.description: Reference the separate restricted consumer NKey identity. absolute canonical protected secret-file path; distinct publisher identity. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

namespace_id.description: Bind subjects and provisioned broker metadata to this deployment. canonical nonzero lower-case UUID string; synthetic example must be replaced deliberately. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

stream.description: Bind the preprovisioned exact owned file stream. 1..64 ASCII characters matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*; no wildcard/dot; differs from consumer. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

consumer.description: Bind the preprovisioned durable pull consumer. 1..64 ASCII characters matching [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*; no wildcard/dot; differs from stream. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

connect_seconds.description: Bound each connection/TLS/auth attempt. integer seconds 1..60, no greater than request_seconds. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

request_seconds.description: Bound broker and task-event SQL operations. integer seconds 1..300; owning root transaction budgets also apply. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

pull_seconds.description: Bound one pull wait. integer seconds 1..request_seconds; each fetch requests one event. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

ack_wait_seconds.description: Allow confirmed SQL handling before broker redelivery. integer seconds 3*request_seconds+pull_seconds ..3600. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

worker_poll_seconds.description: Bound idle publisher/maintenance polling cadence. integer seconds 1..60; cancellation interrupts waits. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

retry_seconds.description: Delay recoverable publication/NAK attempts. integer seconds 1..3600 and no greater than retry_lifetime_seconds. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

reconnect_seconds.description: Delay explicit bounded recovery of a disconnected connection. integer seconds 1..60; no hidden reconnect buffer replay. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

maximum_publish_attempts.description: Bound attempts within one immutable delivery generation. integer count 1..1000; actual unknown outcome retains readback requirement. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

maximum_deliveries.description: Bound application delivery failures before durable SQL DLQ. integer count 1..1000; native MaxDeliver=-1 remains fixed until receipt/DLQ can commit. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

maximum_ack_pending.description: Bound broker in-flight consumer deliveries. integer count 1..64; never native unlimited. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

stream_maximum_messages.description: Bound broker retained event count. integer count maximum_ack_pending ..100000000. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

stream_maximum_bytes.description: Bound broker retained event bytes. integer bytes maximum_ack_pending*5120 ..1099511627776; actual storage admission is additionally required. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

stream_retention_seconds.description: Bound broker message lifetime. integer seconds 60..31536000; expiry is explicit retained SQL DLQ reconciliation. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

duplicate_window_seconds.description: Bound the broker duplicate-ID memory window. integer seconds 1..stream_retention_seconds; SQL inbox supplies longer idempotency proof. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

retry_lifetime_seconds.description: Bound one event transport replay window. integer seconds request_seconds ..stream_retention_seconds. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

history_retention_seconds.description: Retain SQL receipts and history beyond message and retry lifetimes. integer seconds stream_retention_seconds+retry_lifetime_seconds+ack_wait_seconds ..94608000; unresolved effects remain retained. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

cleanup_batch.description: Bound one exact SQL retention/expiry pass. integer rows 1..1000; no prefix purge or physical task mutation. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

shutdown_seconds.description: Bound joined cancellation and connection shutdown. integer seconds request_seconds+pull_seconds ..3600; timeout remains an incomplete stop. Explicit enabled value; restart and exact broker admission required.

maximum_reconnect_attempts.description: Bound consecutive explicit broker reconstruction attempts before controlled service restart is required. Integer attempts 1..1000; persistent stream/consumer creation identity must remain unchanged. Required when enabled; protected environment overrides selected YAML; restart required.

$comment: Runtime validates canonical exact TLS/private IP/path policy, pairwise distinct references and all cross-field inequalities; schema alone is not broker or credential qualification.
